issues.summary: Windows out-of-tree builds can exceed the CreateProcess command-line limit when the SDK path is expanded through a junction or symbolic link.
symptoms: The compiler process cannot be created when a generated command line approaches 32 KB.
remediation: Use the SDK path supplied through FBB_SDK_DIR and keep that path short.
Use the current SDK build utilities, which preserve the non-resolved SDK path for out-of-tree builds.
